preconditions: Source landed and loaded through owner-coordinated idle activation
Check for existing matching verb names; preserve world customizations
commands: do create f193 kind=note title=task-next tags=verb on=house text="# task-next <task> \"<next action>\" \"<acceptance>\"\nread \$1\ndo prop \$1 next_action=\"\$2\" acceptance=\"\$3\" when (\$1.owner = \$me or \$1.lead = \$me or \$1.asked_by = \$me) and \$2 != \"\" and \$3 != \"\""

do create f193 kind=note title=task-revise tags=verb on=house text="# task-revise <task> \"<goal>\" \"<acceptance>\" <request-ref> \"<next action>\"\nread \$1\ndo prop \$1 goal=\"\$2\" acceptance=\"\$3\" request_ref=\"\$4\" next_action=\"\$5\" when (\$1.owner = \$me or \$1.lead = \$me or \$1.asked_by = \$me) and \$2 != \"\" and \$3 != \"\" and \$4 != \"\" and \$5 != \"\""

do create f193 kind=note title=task-review tags=verb on=house text="# task-review <task> <current-basis> "<next action>"
# Read the result first. Review does not verify acceptance or finish a parent.
read \$1
do prop \$1 reviewed_basis=\$2 next_action="\$3" remove=review_at when (\$1.owner = \$me or \$1.lead = \$me or \$1.asked_by = \$me) and \$2 != "" and \$3 != """

do create f193 kind=note title=task-verify tags=verb on=house text="# task-verify <task> <current-basis> <evidence-note>
# Inspect evidence against acceptance first. This is attributed owner verification, not host proof.
# Invalidate first so re-attesting a swapped pointer cannot be a native no-op.
# An interruption between the two writes leaves the task unverified.
read \$1
read \$3
do prop \$1 remove=verified_basis when (\$1.owner = \$me or \$1.lead = \$me or \$1.asked_by = \$me) and \$1.verified_basis != "" and \$2 != "" and \$3 != ""
do prop \$1 verified_basis=\$2 verified_evidence=\$3 when (\$1.owner = \$me or \$1.lead = \$me or \$1.asked_by = \$me) and \$2 != "" and \$3 != """

do create f193 kind=note title=task-followup tags=verb on=house text="# task-followup <task> <ISO-datetime-with-timezone>
# One-shot owner review, never permission, automatic resume or an external action.
read \$1
do prop \$1 review_at="\$2" when (\$1.owner = \$me or \$1.lead = \$me or \$1.asked_by = \$me) and \$2 != """
separate_enable_after_runtime_verificati: look f5189 :1; do prop f5189 next_steps=on
off_switch: look f5189 :1; do prop f5189 next_steps=off
